d:
10 navanbar ko bihar men mausam shushk rahega, rajy men barish ka koee alart nahin hai.
Subah halke se madhyam kohre aur dophar men 30 se 34 digri tak tapman rahne ka anuman hai.
Janie 11 navanbar ko kin jilon men ho sakti hai barish aur kab se barhegi thand.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
